title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech carnage, Dow divergence, oil collapse. Earnings fears slammed XLK -1.84% and SOXX -4.80%, while defensive sectors XLV +2.36% and XLP +1.99% surged. Small caps outperformed large by 0.31pp, bonds rallied (TLT +0.59%), setting a defensive tone ahead of tomorrow’s FOMC decision.

INDICES — VIX 18.2, above its 20d MA 17.0. Returns: DIA +1.08%, SPY +0.24%, IWM +0.16%, QQQ -0.97%, SOXX -4.80%. Small > large by 0.31pp. Cross-asset: USO -3.42% oil plunge, TLT +0.59% bond rally.

VOLUME — SPY and QQQ volume near average (not in gaining/losing lists); SPY up +0.24% on average volume = low‑conviction rally, QQQ down -0.97% on average volume = modest distribution. XLP volume 2.3x with price +1.99% = accumulation, TAN volume 5.2x with price -4.77% = heavy distribution.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV Healthcare +2.36%, XLP Staples +1.99%, XLC Comms +1.87%, XLB Materials +1.85%, XLY Discretionary +1.48%, XLF Financials +1.27%, XLRE Real Estate +0.55%, XLU Utilities -0.35%, XLI Industrials -0.39%, XLE Energy -1.35%, XLK Technology -1.84%. Top Industries: JETS +2.87%, IHI +2.57%; bottom: DRAM -8.89%, SOXX -4.80%. Money out of semiconductors/tech (XLK, SOXX, DRAM) into defensive staples/healthcare (XLV, XLP, JETS). Rotation state: AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation.

POSITIONING — SPY put‑call ratio 1.04, skew +8.1% = elevated fear. QQQ PCR 1.63, skew +10.9% = extreme protection demand. VIX at 18.2 above its 20d MA 17.0, confirming elevated fear. SPY GEX flip at 758, suggesting spot near dealer hedging zone.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil -3.42% and gold -1.40% fell together while TLT +0.59% rose; the disinflationary oil drop normally lifts bonds but gold failed as a safe haven, likely due to a flat dollar (UUP -0.07%) and risk‑off rotation out of commodities.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 63.0 Greed. Top movers: DRAM -8.89% (semis), SOXX -4.80% (semis), UPS -6.57% (freight). 20d momentum: best sector XLV +4.32%, worst XLK -7.72%. Vol spikes: TAN 5.2x (distribution, clean energy breakdown), UPS 3.4x (distribution, earnings skepticism), HII 2.5x (accumulation, defense). DRAM fell on CXMT/Apple supplier fears. Watch: KO (+5.00%, defensive rotation with accumulation), UPS (-6.57%, freight demand signal from vol spike), TAN (-4.77%, breakdown in clean energy momentum).
